description: This file defines the Dispatcher class in the Slim framework, responsible for routing HTTP requests by utilizing the FastRoute library. It implements methods for creating dispatchers, dispatching requests, and retrieving allowed HTTP methods for given URIs.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: Implements the DispatcherInterface to facilitate routing by creating and managing FastRoute dispatchers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Dispatcher with a RouteCollectorInterface instance.

methods.name: createDispatcher
methods.description: Creates and caches a FastRoute dispatcher, using cache if available.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches an HTTP method and URI through the FastRoute dispatcher and returns RoutingResults.

methods.name: getAllowedMethods
methods.description: Returns an array of allowed HTTP methods for a given URI.
